en.question: A developer wants Claude Code to stop reading a large generated directory that wastes context on every session. Where does that belong?

options.text: Typed as a reminder at the beginning of each new working session.
options.note: Manual repetition every session, by every developer, indefinitely.

options.text: In committed project configuration and CLAUDE.md, so it applies to everyone.
In a custom slash command the developer invokes before starting work.
options.note: Still requires someone to remember to invoke it.

options.text: In a subagent definition that handles work touching that directory.
options.note: Subagents isolate context for delegated subtasks, not project-wide exclusions.

en.explanation: A persistent, project-wide, team-shared fact belongs in committed project configuration, because anything depending on a human remembering will eventually be forgotten by someone.
